utterances.text: Hello dear, how was your day?
Hi Grandma! My day was pretty good, just busy with schoolwork.
That's good to hear! What did you do at school today?
It was mostly lectures, but I finished a big project I've been working on.
You always work so hard. Is it the one about the history of horses?
Exactly, Grandma! I was talking about that history project, specifically the part about horses.
Alright, dear, if you need help proofreading anything, just let me know.
Thanks, Grandma. I'll let you know if I need a second pair of eyes.
I'm glad to hear that, dear. Is there anything else special you want to share about your day?
Well, I did get an A on my math test, which was pretty exciting!
Oh, an A in math! That's wonderful! Was it a very difficult test?
It was quite a challenge, but I studied really hard for it.
I see! You really earned that grade. Let's see if we can celebrate that for you.
Would you like to go see the stables together later to celebrate?
Sure, I'd love to go see the horses with you later!
That's lovely, dear. If you change your mind, just let me know.
Thanks, Grandma! I'll let you know if anything changes.
Alright, sweetheart. If there's anything else you'd like to do, just let me know.
I really appreciate how thoughtful you are, Grandma. Maybe we can also bake some cookies together later?
Oh, baking cookies sounds like a treat! Should we make the ones with the chess patterns?
That's a great idea! Chess cookies would be perfect for our afternoon.
Oh, what are you showing me on your screen, dear?
I'm showing you the recipe for the cookies we can bake together. Do you want to take a look?
Oh, I see! That's a very clear list of instructions, dear.
Great! Let's start with gathering the ingredients. Do you have everything we need?
I should have it all. It reminds me of when I used to play chess with your grandpa while waiting for the oven.
I love hearing those stories! Maybe we can play a match while our cookies are baking?
I'd like that. I'll even show you how to move the knight effectively; it's the piece that moves in an L-shape.
Oh, I'd love that! The knight is one of my favorite pieces because of its unique move.
Alright, I'll take the white pieces then. Let's have a fun game!
Great! I'll set up the board now. I'm excited to see how this match goes.
Okay, let's start. I'm looking forward to it!
utterances.raw: look forward, can be considered as express
